objective: Decide the CPU-kick strictness required for the current MobileViT ImageNet/scoped accuracy goal.

decision.accepted_for: current MobileViT ImageNet or approved scoped-subset accuracy measurement
decision.rationale: The current goal is to measure model accuracy through a CPU-visible kick flow. Requiring RTL or full CPU-core execution would create a separate implementation goal and would not change the classification accuracy calculation once the same MobileViT inference path and labels are used.

remaining_requirements_for_goal_completi: ImageNet validation or approved scoped-subset manifest with labels
CPU-kick inference predictions for the selected manifest
non_claims: not ImageNet accuracy measurement by itself
